entities.summary: Andrew Jordan Cole is an American former professional baseball pitcher. He has previously played in Major League Baseball (MLB) for the Washington Nationals, New York Yankees, Cleveland Indians, and Toronto Blue Jays, and in Nippon Professional Baseball (NPB) for the Tokyo Yakult Swallows.
